description: This file defines the implementation of the WmediumdServer class and related setup features for managing the wmediumd server within the Cuttlefish project. It includes class definitions, method implementations, and dependencies related to starting, configuring, and waiting for the wmediumd server, which is used for Wi-Fi medium simulation.

classes.name: ValidateWmediumdService
classes.description: A setup feature class that waits for the wmediumd server to be ready, used when the server is not launched automatically.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates the commands to start the wmediumd server with appropriate parameters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the server.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the wmediumd server should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: WaitForAvailability
methods.description: Waits until the wmediumd server is available and ready.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the wmediumd server setup.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Performs setup steps for the wmediumd server, including configuration generation.
